attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file DC franchise tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in DC (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "DC" streq } over if
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "DC" streq } over if

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
// No nexus - no filing required; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set result.dc_minimum_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate DC state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate DC state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_dsl: // Calculate DC state additions and subtractions; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0;
// No nexus - no adjustments; set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate DC corporate franchise tax. Applies 8.25% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_dsl: // DC uses 8.25% flat rate; set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_taxable_income * apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits;
// No DC nexus - no tax liability; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0; set result.dc_minimum_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income - minimum tax applies
action_details.action_dsl: // No income-based tax, but minimum tax still applies; set apportionment.state_tax = 0.0;

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate DC minimum franchise tax based on gross receipts. Final tax is greater of income-based tax or minimum tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe minimum tax
condition_details.condition_dsl: apportionment.has_economic_nexus is true or apportionment.has_physical_presence is true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_dsl: // Minimum tax: $1,000 for gross receipts > $1M; set result.dc_minimum_tax = 1000.0; set apportionment.state_tax = max(apportionment.state_tax, result.dc_minimum_tax); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;

set result.dc_minimum_tax = 250.0; if apportionment.state_tax > result.dc_minimum_tax then set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_tax; else set apportionment.state_tax = result.dc_minimum_tax; endif set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: 250.0 cvd /result.dc_minimum_tax xdef { apportionment.state_tax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef } { result.dc_minimum_tax cvi /apportionment.state_tax xdef } apportionment.state_tax result.dc_minimum_tax f> ifelse apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax - cvi /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_dsl: // No DC nexus - no minimum tax requirement; set result.dc_minimum_tax = 0.0; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments;
